name: real_world_modi_pstack_distributed_19sc_20260728
description: Copy-only distributed urban-follower experiment. Keeps the validated real-world freeway/VSL/ramp setup, but expands urban signal control from one SC1 interface lever to SC1-SC19 individual urban follower agents.
notes: This is an experiment config, not a promoted baseline.
SC1 receives the freeway-interface ramp/off-ramp coupling; SC2-SC19 are independent local signal players from signal-head link observations.
The first smoke should be short because 19 urban agents enlarge the signal action space.
